name: File System Operations
description: Tools for reading, creating, listing, and manipulating local files and directories.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Reads the full contents of a local text file.

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Creates a file on the local system with the specified content.

filepath.description: Relative path of the file to create.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: Lists files and subdirectories for a local path.

dirPath.description: Directory path to list. Empty means the current directory.
